questions.problem:
Calculate the determinant of the matrix
$Z=[\begin{aligned}\frac{1}{2} & 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 5 & 0 & -2 & 0 \\ 1 & 5 & 3 & 2 \\ 1 & 2 & 3 & 8\end{aligned}]$
questions.worked_solution:
We use the cofactor expansion along the first row:

$$
\begin{aligned}det(Z) & ={z}_{11}{C}_{11}+{z}_{12}{C}_{12}+{z}_{13}{C}_{13}+{z}_{14}{C}_{14} \\  & =\frac{1}{2}\cdot {C}_{11}+0\cdot {C}_{12}+0\cdot {C}_{13}+0\cdot {C}_{14} \\  & =\frac{1}{2}{C}_{11} \\  & =\frac{1}{2}\cdot |\begin{aligned}\frac{1}{2} & ∗ & ∗ & ∗ \\ ∗ & 0 & -2 & 0 \\ ∗ & 5 & 3 & 2 \\ ∗ & 2 & 3 & 8\end{aligned}| \\  & =\frac{1}{2}(-1)^{1+1}|\begin{aligned}0 & -2 & 0 \\ 5 & 3 & 2 \\ 2 & 3 & 8\end{aligned}| \\  & =\frac{1}{2}(0\cdot |\begin{aligned}3 & 2 \\ 3 & 8\end{aligned}|-(-2)\cdot |\begin{aligned}5 & 2 \\ 2 & 8\end{aligned}|+0\cdot |\begin{aligned}5 & 3 \\ 2 & 3\end{aligned}|) \\  & =\frac{1}{2}(0+2(5\cdot 8-2\cdot 2)+0) \\  & =\frac{1}{2}\cdot 72 \\  & =36\end{aligned}
$$

questions.problem:
Calculate the determinant of the matrix
$S=[\begin{aligned}0 & 2 & 0 & 0 \\ 1 & 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 1 & 2 & -5 & 4 \\ 4 & 0 & 2 & 2\end{aligned}].$
questions.worked_solution:
We use the cofactor expansion along the first row:

$$
\begin{aligned}det(S) & ={s}_{11}{C}_{11}+{s}_{12}{C}_{12}+{s}_{13}{C}_{13}+{s}_{14}{C}_{14} \\  & =0\cdot {C}_{11}+2\cdot {C}_{12}+0\cdot {C}_{13}+0\cdot {C}_{14} \\  & =2{C}_{12} \\  & =2\cdot |\begin{aligned}∗ & 2 & ∗ & ∗ \\ 1 & ∗ & 0 & 0 \\ 1 & ∗ & -5 & 4 \\ 4 & ∗ & 2 & 2\end{aligned}| \\  & =2(-1)^{1+2}|\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 0 \\ 1 & -5 & 4 \\ 4 & 2 & 2\end{aligned}| \\  & =-2(1\cdot |\begin{aligned}-5 & 4 \\ 2 & 2\end{aligned}|-0\cdot |\begin{aligned}1 & 4 \\ 4 & 2\end{aligned}|+0\cdot |\begin{aligned}1 & -5 \\ 4 & 2\end{aligned}|) \\  & =-2((-5\cdot 2-4\cdot 2)-0+0) \\  & =-2\cdot (-18) \\  & =36\end{aligned}
$$

questions.problem:

$T=[\begin{aligned}-1 & 0 & 4 & 0 \\ 9 & 0 & 0 & 0 \\ -1 & 6 & 0 & 2 \\ 1 & 0 & 3 & -2\end{aligned}].$
questions.worked_solution:
We use the cofactor expansion along the first row:

$$
\begin{aligned}det(T) & ={t}_{11}{C}_{11}+{t}_{12}{C}_{12}+{t}_{13}{C}_{13}+{t}_{14}{C}_{14} \\  & =(-1)\cdot {C}_{11}+0\cdot {C}_{12}+4\cdot {C}_{13}+0\cdot {C}_{14} \\  & =-{C}_{11}+4{C}_{13} \\  & =(-1)\cdot |\begin{aligned}-1 & ∗ & ∗ & ∗ \\ ∗ & 0 & 0 & 0 \\ ∗ & 6 & 0 & 2 \\ ∗ & 0 & 3 & -2\end{aligned}|+4\cdot |\begin{aligned}∗ & ∗ & 4 & ∗ \\ 9 & 0 & ∗ & 0 \\ -1 & 6 & ∗ & 2 \\ 1 & 0 & ∗ & -2\end{aligned}| \\  & =(-1)\cdot (-1)^{1+1}|\begin{aligned}0 & 0 & 0 \\ 6 & 0 & 2 \\ 0 & 3 & -2\end{aligned}|+4\cdot (-1)^{1+3}|\begin{aligned}9 & 0 & 0 \\ -1 & 6 & 2 \\ 1 & 0 & -2\end{aligned}| \\  & =-(0\cdot |\begin{aligned}0 & 2 \\ 3 & -2\end{aligned}|-0\cdot |\begin{aligned}6 & 2 \\ 0 & -2\end{aligned}|+0\cdot |\begin{aligned}6 & 0 \\ 0 & 3\end{aligned}|)+4(9\cdot |\begin{aligned}6 & 2 \\ 0 & -2\end{aligned}|-0\cdot |\begin{aligned}-1 & 2 \\ 1 & -2\end{aligned}|+0\cdot |\begin{aligned}-1 & 6 \\ 1 & 0\end{aligned}|) \\  & =-0+4\cdot 9(6\cdot (-2)-2\cdot 0) \\  & =36\cdot (-12) \\  & =-432\end{aligned}
$$

questions.problem:
Calculate the determinant of the matrix
$A=[\begin{aligned}-3 & 0 & 0 & 5 \\ 0 & 0 & 3 & -2 \\ 4 & -1 & 2 & -3 \\ -1 & 6 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}].$
questions.worked_solution:
We use the cofactor expansion along the first row:

$$
\begin{aligned}det(A) & ={a}_{11}{C}_{11}+{a}_{12}{C}_{12}+{a}_{13}{C}_{13}+{a}_{14}{C}_{14} \\  & =(-3)\cdot {C}_{11}+0\cdot {C}_{12}+0\cdot {C}_{13}+5\cdot {C}_{14} \\  & =-3{C}_{11}+5{C}_{14} \\  & =(-3)\cdot |\begin{aligned}-3 & ∗ & ∗ & ∗ \\ ∗ & 0 & 3 & -2 \\ ∗ & -1 & 2 & -3 \\ ∗ & 6 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}|+5\cdot |\begin{aligned}∗ & ∗ & ∗ & 5 \\ 0 & 0 & 3 & ∗ \\ 4 & -1 & 2 & ∗ \\ -1 & 6 & 0 & ∗\end{aligned}| \\  & =(-3)(-1)^{1+1}|\begin{aligned}0 & 3 & -2 \\ -1 & 2 & -3 \\ 6 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}|+5(-1)^{1+4}|\begin{aligned}0 & 0 & 3 \\ 4 & -1 & 2 \\ -1 & 6 & 0\end{aligned}| \\  & =-3|\begin{aligned}0 & 3 & -2 \\ -1 & 2 & -3 \\ 6 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}|-5|\begin{aligned}0 & 0 & 3 \\ 4 & -1 & 2 \\ -1 & 6 & 0\end{aligned}| \\  & =-3(0\cdot |\begin{aligned}2 & -3 \\ 0 & 0\end{aligned}|-3\cdot |\begin{aligned}-1 & -3 \\ 6 & 0\end{aligned}|-2\cdot |\begin{aligned}-1 & 2 \\ 6 & 0\end{aligned}|) \\  & -5(0\cdot |\begin{aligned}-1 & 2 \\ 6 & 0\end{aligned}|-0\cdot |\begin{aligned}4 & 2 \\ -1 & 0\end{aligned}|+3\cdot |\begin{aligned}4 & -1 \\ -1 & 6\end{aligned}|) \\  & =-3\cdot (-3\cdot (0+18)+(-2)\cdot (0-12))-5\cdot (3\cdot (24-1)) \\  & =90-345 \\  & =-255\end{aligned}
$$

questions.problem:
Calculate the determinant of the matrix
$Z=[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & -1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & -2 & 0 \\ 0 & -3 & 5 & 4 \\ 0 & 4 & 3 & 5\end{aligned}].$
questions.worked_solution:
We use the cofactor expansion along the first row:

$$
\begin{aligned}det(Z) & ={z}_{11}{C}_{11}+{z}_{12}{C}_{12}+{z}_{13}{C}_{13}+{z}_{14}{C}_{14} \\  & =1\cdot {C}_{11}+0\cdot {C}_{12}+(-1)\cdot {C}_{13}+0\cdot {C}_{14} \\  & ={C}_{11}-{C}_{13} \\  & =1\cdot |\begin{aligned}1 & ∗ & ∗ & ∗ \\ ∗ & 0 & -2 & 0 \\ ∗ & -3 & 5 & 4 \\ ∗ & 4 & 3 & 5\end{aligned}|+(-1)\cdot |\begin{aligned}∗ & ∗ & -1 & ∗ \\ 0 & 0 & ∗ & 0 \\ 0 & -3 & ∗ & 4 \\ 0 & 4 & ∗ & 5\end{aligned}| \\  & =1\cdot (-1)^{1+1}|\begin{aligned}0 & -2 & 0 \\ -3 & 5 & 4 \\ 4 & 3 & 5\end{aligned}|+(-1)\cdot (-1)^{1+3}|\begin{aligned}0 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & -3 & 4 \\ 0 & 4 & 5\end{aligned}| \\  & =|\begin{aligned}0 & -2 & 0 \\ -3 & 5 & 4 \\ 4 & 3 & 5\end{aligned}|-|\begin{aligned}0 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & -3 & 4 \\ 0 & 4 & 5\end{aligned}| \\  & =(0\cdot |\begin{aligned}5 & 4 \\ 3 & 5\end{aligned}|-(-2)\cdot |\begin{aligned}-3 & 4 \\ 4 & 5\end{aligned}|+0\cdot |\begin{aligned}-3 & 5 \\ 4 & 3\end{aligned}|)-(0\cdot |\begin{aligned}-3 & 4 \\ 4 & 5\end{aligned}|-0\cdot |\begin{aligned}0 & 4 \\ 0 & 5\end{aligned}|+0\cdot |\begin{aligned}0 & -3 \\ 0 & 4\end{aligned}|) \\  & =0+2\cdot |\begin{aligned}-3 & 4 \\ 4 & 5\end{aligned}|+0-(0-0+0) \\  & =2\cdot |\begin{aligned}-3 & 4 \\ 4 & 5\end{aligned}| \\  & =2((-3)\cdot 5-4\cdot 4) \\  & =2\cdot (-31) \\  & =-62\end{aligned}
$$
